problem: Each GROUP member was checked by scanning model space, paper space, and every user-block entity vector, repeating whole-output membership work for each member.

details: Added a lazy sorted member-target handle view derived from the existing owner+handle ledger, which is already bounded at MaxDwgReadObjectCount.
Replaced repeated per-member owner-vector scans with binary search in the derived view; duplicate-member and missing-member checks remain unchanged.
Invalidate the derived index after a successful entity registration, transaction rollback, or writer-state initialization so retries cannot use stale membership.
The temporary vector is limited to one million 32-bit handles (about 3.82 MiB); no persistent per-entity state or wire format changed.
implementation.complexity: For E indexed entities and M total GROUP references, repeated membership work changes from O(M*E) vector scans to one O(E log E) sort and O(M log E) lookups. No elapsed-time benchmark or RSS measurement is claimed.
implementation.wire_behavior: No serialized field, handle ordering, public API, or support claim changed.

next_local_work: Continue the next source-backed local 7S retained-work or membership-scan audit; external qualification remains advisory and non-blocking.
repository_state: Broadly dirty shared worktree; .git metadata is read-only, so the slice remains uncommitted.
